persona_snapshot.name: Tech-savvy sysadmin
persona_snapshot.summary: Has already checked the obvious things and wants someone to act on the diagnosis.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Dry and precise. Uses jargon like MX record, propagation, TTL, and dig, and skips pleasantries.

scenario_snapshot.title: Plan upgrade from a full mailbox
scenario_snapshot.description: A full mailbox is bouncing mail. The bot should find the cause and offer the right upgrade, not guess.
scenario_snapshot.goal: Clients say their emails to you are bouncing, and you need it fixed today.

facts.name: Aisha Rahman
facts.will_not_delete_mail: You need to keep every message for legal records

beats.instruction: Say clients are telling you email to you is bouncing.
Give your mailbox address, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
If told to delete old mail, say you can't because you have to keep it all, and ask what else you can do.
beats.checkpoint: The caller ruled out deleting mail.

beats.instruction: Ask what the next plan up costs and how much space it gives, then say yes.

must.text: Verify the caller before sharing mailbox details.
Say the mailbox is full at 5 GB.
Quote Email Plus at $12.00 a month with 25 GB before changing the plan.

must_not.text: Change the plan before the caller agrees.

expected_state.description: The customer is on Email Plus.
The mailbox has the new quota.
